0022600200.text: The Bucks host the Celtics in their 10th game of the season, with Milwaukee (1-8, 1-4 at home, 15th in the East) on a five-game losing streak while Boston (7-2, 2nd in the East) has won two straight. Milwaukee's Gary Trent Jr. and Boston's Mitchell Robinson are both day-to-day with illness and are listed as game-time decisions. The Bucks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 109-102 in Boston on November 4, 2026, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
